newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico says considering new suburban railway.
newsitem.headline: Mexico says considering new suburban railway.

text.p: Mexico's Transport and Communications Ministry said late on Monday it is considering building a suburban transportation system in Mexico City for residents in the outskirts of the city.
"The nation's capital is currently the only city of its size that does not have a suburban railway, like New York, Paris or London," the ministry said in a statement.
It said the railway would help the commute of the thousands of workers that live in the capital's outlying regions and travel daily to jobs in the city.
The ministry said foreign companies, specifically an unnamed French company, have expressed their interest in the project.
France's GEC Alsthom, a joint venture of Alcatal Alsthom and GEC Plc, has repaired cars on Mexico City's subway. Mexican builders ICA and Grupo Tribasa have also worked on the subway.
